summary: Third pass — targeted retest of the iteration_2 admin/watermark bug + backend regression after the CORS change. Backend: 17/17 pytest tests pass (auth/entitlements/limits, /billing/plans, free gates for n_clips/tighten/multilingual/gameplay, share mint+idempotency+public read+view increment+invalid-token 404, watermark frozen onto job.options, timestamps carry UTC offset). No regression from the CLIPPER_CORS_ORIGINS refactor. Frontend admin flow: logged in as admin@clipper.test, opened Studio, verified [data-testid=unlock-strip] is ABSENT on step 2, opt-multilingual/opt-tighten/opt-template-gameplay all render WITHOUT the 'locked' class, and [data-testid=watermark-note] is ABSENT on step 3 — the review even shows 'Cost: 20 of your 100 credits' with no watermark note. Bug fixed. Frontend free flow: fresh registered user shows wizard-limits reading 'Your plan: up to 2 clips per video, sources up to 30 min. Need more?', all three gated controls carry the 'locked' class, opening any of them opens [data-testid=upgrade-modal], the unlock-strip is present on step 2, and the watermark-note is present on step 3 with the 'Remove it' upgrade CTA.
critical_code_review_comments: usePlan.js — good refactor: isFree derived from entitlements.length===0 and watermarked from !can('no_watermark'). Presentation flags now match server truth for the ADMIN_EMAILS bypass and any future comped account.
StudioWizard.jsx — anyLocked correctly derived from individual can(...) checks instead of plan string. No further coupling to plan name in the review gating.
main.py CORS — CLIPPER_CORS_ORIGINS env variable respected with sensible localhost fallback. No regression across the tested surface.

Nit: hero-continue-btn from the landing page fills source+advances the wizard past step 1 in one shot. wizard-limits therefore only shows when a user manually navigates back to step 1 — acceptable, but worth confirming intentional.
Nit (unchanged from iter_2): concurrent /rerender and /export on the same clip use SessionLocal without a lock; theoretical race, not observed.
test_credentials: admin@clipper.test / clipperadmin123 (verified). Fresh TEST_free_<ts>@example.com registered per module for the free-plan matrix.
seed_data_creation: None — reused existing demo-job-0001. No re-seed was required.
context_for_next_testing_agent: iteration_2 MEDIUM bug is fixed and verified from both sides (admin-no-watermark-note, free-still-watermarked). Backend surface unchanged and 100% green after the CORS env-var refactor. Frontend selectors used: studio-wizard, wizard-step-source, wizard-next, wizard-back, wizard-panel-source/prefs/review, wizard-limits, unlock-strip, opt-multilingual/opt-tighten/opt-template-gameplay, watermark-note, upgrade-modal. Note that .editor-backdrop can intercept clicks after certain UI transitions — Playwright scripts should fall back to JS click (element.click()) or remove that overlay before interacting with wizard buttons. Emoji-in-title issue explicitly deferred by user and not re-tested.
rca of the issue: Root cause was in /app/frontend/src/usePlan.js which derived isFree from user.plan==='free'. Admin accounts have plan='free' but every entitlement via ADMIN_EMAILS bypass, so the admin review step showed a watermark note contradicting /api/auth/me. Fix: isFree = entitlements.length===0, watermarked = !can('no_watermark'). StudioWizard.jsx also updated to derive anyLocked from individual can() checks, and the watermark-note is gated on plan.watermarked instead of isFree. Verified: admin sees NO watermark-note and NO unlock-strip; free user still sees both.
